title: Late-Fee Relief Size and Returned Payments — PracticePay Patient Financing
content:
**Rule.** For a late-fee relief on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan, the late-fee relief size follows the plan's returned-payment record: when the plan shows two or more returned-payment entries dated within the last 6 months, the relief size is the part of the late fee above 5.00 USD, never below 0.00 and never more than 10.00 USD; when it shows exactly one, the relief size is the part of the late fee above 5.00 USD, never below 0.00; when it shows none, the relief size is the late fee in full; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Returned-payment entries on the plan within the last 6 months | Relief size |
|---|---|
| none | the late fee in full |
| exactly one | the late fee less 5.00, never below 0.00 |
| two or more | the late fee less 5.00, never below 0.00 and never more than 10.00 |

## Figures (hypothetical late fees)

| Late fee | No returns | One return | Two or more returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30.00 | 30.00 | 25.00 | 10.00 |
| 12.00 | 12.00 | 7.00 | 7.00 |
| 4.00 | 4.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A return dated exactly 6 whole months before the relief date is outside the window; one dated a day later is inside it.
